newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Investments ventures into Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Investments ventures into Latin America.

text.p: The largest mutual fund company in the United States, Fidelity Investments, said Tuesday it was opening offices in Argentina, Brazil and Chile - its first venture into Latin America.

The privately-held mutual fund company with more than $511 billion in assets under management as of April 30 hopes to take advantage of the recent privitization of pension funds in the three countries, said John Hailer, Fidelity's senior vice president for Latin America.
Fidelity hopes to provide institutional businesses in Buenos Aires, Sao Paulo and Santiago with back-office support and services, Hailer said.

In the United States Fidelity Investment Institutional Services provides investment products and related services to professionals at more than 2,000 broker-dealers, 950 banks and 32 insurance companies.

Hailer noted that in the United States one out of every three people had mutual fund investments, but in Brazil, the world's 10th largest economy, only one out of 200 people held mutual fund investments.
"We think there's a tremendous opportunity for growth. Especially with the privatization of the pension funds," he said.
